rows: Hub 9, located in the Fringe Sector, is where all our logistics operations begin. It's a base for recruiting companions and a safe haven that shelters us from the storm—whether literal or metaphorical. It's home.

Situé dans le Secteur périphérique, le Hub 9 est notre base pour le recrutement de compagnons, un port sûr qui nous protège des intempéries, ainsi que le point de départ de toutes nos activités logistiques.

In the wake of war and disaster, a small number of the Mariani and Chelae were stranded at the port of this massive Shard. It might not be their true home, but right now it's the only refuge they have—and sooner or later, they're going to have to reckon with the fact that they both now share a struggle for survival.

Après les guerres et les catastrophes, un petit groupe de Mariana et de Chelae s'est retrouvé abandonné dans le port de cet éclat géant. Face aux luttes, aux désaccords et aux dilemmes de survie, cet endroit n'est pas leur foyer, mais il reste le seul refuge pour ces parias.

Located far from Acme in a remote sector of Shards, this one is home to FarDash Logistics' Hub 9. Although it has fallen into ruin and is now overrun by scavengers, the Fringe Sector is still full of opportunity for those clever enough to seize it.

Éloigné de SIGNATURE ACME, cet éclat situé dans un secteur reculé abrite le Hub 9 de la logistique. Bien qu'il soit aujourd'hui devenu une ruine occupée par des voyous, cet éclat regorge toujours d'opportunités.
Description de la Carte de test
(Aucun paramètre, pour test temporaire) Port côtier

After the "Second Smash-Up," exiled refugees established their main camp on the outskirts of Harmony Town. They survived by scavenging the remnants of civilization and dismantling old facilities, and under the Scavenger King's Control, they gradually became Scavengers.

Après le « deuxième l’Effondrement », les réfugiés exilés ont établi leur campement principal à la périphérie de Ville fantôme. Ils survivent en collectant des Ruines décomposées et en démantelant de vieilles installations, devenant progressivement des Charognards sous le Contrôle du Roi des charognards.
A narrow path leading to the Dragon's Nest. Towering cliffs rise on both sides, and in ancient times it would surely have been an ideal place to defend and hard to attack.
Un sentier étroit menant au Repaire du dragon furieux. Bordé de chaque côté par des falaises imposantes, ce serait certainement un endroit imprenable s'il se trouvait dans les temps anciens.

A great tree has already lost the life within it, yet its remains still silently keep watch over this sea. The Mariana people established an outpost here as a base point, together with the coastal outpost as the front line watching over the coast.

Un grand arbre qui a perdu sa vitalité, mais dont les restes continuent de veiller silencieusement sur cette mer. Le peuple de Mariana y a établi un avant-poste comme point de base, servant, avec l'Avant-poste côtier, de ligne de front pour surveiller la côte.
No one knows how many years ago, a colossal beast died quietly on this land. After day after day of wind and sun, only these grim white bones remain, bearing witness to the traces of ages past.

Il y a d'innombrables années, une bête géante est morte paisiblement sur cette terre. Après avoir été exposés au vent et au soleil jour après jour, il ne reste plus que ces ossements blancs et sinistres, témoignant des traces des années passées.
No one knows how many years ago, a meteor from light-years away fell from the sky. And this massive ring-shaped crater is the land's final gift it left behind.
Il y a d'innombrables années, une météorite venue de plusieurs années-lumière est tombée du ciel. Cet immense cratère est le dernier cadeau qu'elle a laissé à cette terre.
The Seaside Outpost lies in the most remote corner of Seaside Port, where the Mariana people are stationed, keeping watch against threats from the outside world.
L'Avant-poste côtier est situé dans un coin de la ville le plus reculé du Port côtier, où les Marianas sont stationnés, se méfiant des menaces venant du monde extérieur.

To defend themselves, a group of the weakest humans united. Despite lacking strong physiques and special abilities, they relied on themselves to establish their own civilization in the Shardverse. They became the Mad Dragon Gang.

Afin de se DÉFENDRE VOUS-MÊME, un groupe d'humains les plus faibles s'est uni. Bien qu'ils ne possèdent ni physique robuste ni capacités spéciales, ils ont réussi à établir leur propre civilisation dans l'éclatsverse par leurs propres moyens. Ils sont ainsi devenus le Gang du Dragon Enragé.

The Main District is the most central and prosperous area of the entire Seaside Port, and it also connects the Mariana, Chelae, Orcs, and the Mad Dragon Gang, gradually developing into a gathering place of considerable scale.

La Ville principale est la zone la plus centrale et la plus prospère de tout le Port côtier. Reliant les habitants de Mariana, les Chelae, les Orcs et le Gang du Dragon enragé, elle s'est progressivement développée pour devenir un lieu de rassemblement d'une certaine envergure.

A high vantage point on the outskirts of Harmony Town, offering a view of the town district, the factory district, and the Scavengers camp. Kepler uses this place as an outpost to monitor nearby activity.

Situé sur les hauteurs à la périphérie de Ville fantôme, ce point de vue permet d'observer la zone urbaine, la zone industrielle et le Camp des Charognards. L'escouade Kepler l'utilise comme poste de surveillance pour guider les mouvements aux alentours.
The old lighthouse on the outskirts of Harmony Town is a landmark for observing the surroundings and finding your bearings. Kepler still occupies it and uses it as an outer perimeter watchpost.

Le vieux Phare situé à la lisière de la Ville de l'Harmonie est un point de repère pour observer les environs et s'orienter. Kepler occupe toujours cet endroit, l'utilisant comme point de prévention des crises extérieur.

A neutral trade zone located at the crossroads of multiple factions. Orcs, Chelae, and Mariana can all exchange supplies here. The shared demand for supplies among all sides sustains the fragile yet precious peace here.

Zone d'échange NEUTRE située à la jonction de plusieurs forces. Les Orcs, les Chelae et les habitants de Mariana peuvent y échanger des fournitures. Le besoin commun de ressources de toutes les parties maintient ici une paix aussi Fragilité que précieuse.
The outpost located between Mariana and the Chelae is the Chelae's forward post for monitoring Mariana, and also the tether that sustains the fragile and temporary peace between the two lands.
L'avant-poste situé entre les Mariana et les Chelae sert de poste de surveillance des Chelae sur les Mariana, tout en étant le lien qui maintient une paix fragile et temporaire entre les deux terres.
An old Signal Tower located at a road intersection. Scavengers use the existing structure to watch the roads and relay simple signals to the camp.
Une ancienne balise située à l'intersection des routes. Les Charognards utilisent la structure existante pour surveiller la route et transmettre des signaux simples au camp.

The industrial mountain region occupied by the Orcs has ore, water sources, factories, and energy facilities, but it uniquely lacks the salt needed to sustain life. The Orcs rely on mining and smelting to build their homeland, and as a result they maintain an important trade relationship with the Mariana, who control sea salt.

La région montagneuse industrielle occupée par les Orques possède des minerais, de l'Eau, des usines et des installations pour fournir de l'énergie, mais manque cruellement du Sel nécessaire à la vie quotidienne. Les Orques ont bâti leur foyer sur l'exploitation minière et la forge, et entretiennent ainsi des relations commerciales cruciales avec les habitants de Mariana, qui contrôlent le sel marin.
The Orcs built a photovoltaic power station here; while Akhet's scorching sunlight brings warmth, it also provides the Orcs with the energy they rely on to live.
La centrale photovoltaïque établie ici par les orcs, alors que le soleil brûlant d'Akhet apporte de la chaleur, elle fournit également aux orcs l'énergie dont ils dépendent pour vivre et moi.
The Orcs Core, a stronghold garrisoned by Orcs. Its architectural style showcases their wild and punk nature, making it second to none even throughout the Shardverse.
Usine de base des Orcs, un lieu où les Orcs sont stationnés. Leur style architectural affiche leur nature de Croissance sauvage et de Punk, étant sans égal dans tout le Éclatverse.
The Orcs' outpost, beneath a massive billboard, looks down from high ground over the main city district, and no passerby can escape their eyes.
L'Avant-poste des Orques, situé sous un immense panneau publicitaire, offre un Terrain élevé surplombant la Ville principale, de sorte qu'aucun passant ne peut échapper à leurs yeux.
On the only road to the Chelae Camp, the rising ring remains unfinished, like the uncertain fate of the people who live on this land.
Le passage obligé pour ALLER au camp des Parias, l'anneau s'élevant n'est pas encore achevé, tout comme le destin incertain des sujets vivant sur cette terre.
Originally a residential area for factory personnel and local residents. With the Kepler faction's retreat, most buildings were abandoned, but the main roads are still under Kepler control.

Zone initialement destinée au logement du personnel de l'usine et des résidents. Suite à la Retraite des forces de Kepler, la plupart des bâtiments ont été abandonnés, mais les routes principales restent actuellement sous Contrôle ! de Kepler.
A key supply point between Harmony Town and the factory district. Kepler still controls this place, providing fuel for a small garrison force and transport vehicles.

Un point de ravitaillement important entre Ville fantôme et la zone industrielle. Kepler en garde toujours le Contrôle, fournissant du CARBURANT pour les quelques forces stationnées et les véhicules de transport.
The low-lying swamp between Harmony Town and the Scavengers camp. The complex terrain provides cover for the thugs and also hinders Kepler's advance toward the camp.
Marécage bas situé entre Ville de l'Harmonie et le Camp des Charognards. Le terrain Complexe offre une couverture aux Charognards et entrave la Diminution de la vitesse de Kepler vers le camp.

The original medical facilities of Harmony Town. The drugs were once used to alleviate the symptoms of refugees suffering from glial contamination, and the remaining medicines bear signs of having been looted by Scavengers.

Les installations médicales d'origine de Ville fantôme. Les médicaments étaient utilisés pour soulager les symptômes de la pollution par Glunite chez les réfugiés, et les restes de médicaments portent des traces de pillage par les Charognards.

The original municipal center of Harmony Town. As the Kepler faction declined, this place became one of the few remaining administrative outposts it still maintained, used to monitor the town district and surrounding facilities.

L'ancien centre municipal de Ville fantôme. Avec le déclin de la faction Kepler, cet endroit est devenu l'un des rares bastions administratifs encore maintenus, utilisé pour surveiller la zone urbaine et les installations environnantes.

The residents of Harmony Town once relied on Kepler's factories and facilities to survive, but after the Second Smash-Up, Kepler's presence faded. The established order and supply lines collapsed, leaving only abandoned facilities and a lingering glunite contamination that continues to infect humanoid bodies. Today, Kepler only controls a handful of key strongholds, while Scavengers occupy the majority of the rest of the town.

Les habitants de Ville fantôme dépendaient à l'origine des usines et des installations de Kepler pour leur survie. Après le second Smash Up, l'influence de Kepler s'est progressivement éloignée, entraînant la désintégration de l'ordre et de l'approvisionnement d'origine, ne laissant derrière elle que des installations abandonnées et une Pollution accélérée par la Glunite qui contamine continuellement le corps humain. Aujourd'hui, Kepler ne détient le Contrôle que de quelques points d'ancrage cruciaux, tandis que les Charognards occupent la majeure partie des quartiers abandonnés.
Once the commercial hub of Harmony Town. Today it is controlled by Kepler's garrison forces and unmanned devices, and the shops that once served residents have long since ceased operations.

L'ancien centre commercial de Ville fantôme. Aujourd'hui, cet endroit est sous le Contrôle des forces de Montagne glacée et d'Appareils portables, et les boutiques qui servaient autrefois les habitants ont depuis longtemps cessé de fonctionner.
A scrap yard piled high with trash, where everyone tacitly treated it as a safe zone and dumped their discarded items here.
Une Casse où les déchets s'accumulent comme des montagnes, que tout le monde a tacitement acceptée comme une zone de paix, et où chacun vient entasser ses objets au rebut.

A wreckage zone formed by the accumulation of large numbers of abandoned ships. Supplies are buried within it, and it also preserves the memories of Mariana clansmen who never returned. The Gravekeeper is stationed here year-round, recording those who enter the shipwrecks and protecting important relics.

Une zone de débris formée par l'accumulation d'un grand nombre de navires abandonnés, où sont enfouies des fournitures et conservés les souvenirs des membres du peuple de Mariana qui ne sont jamais revenus. Les gardiens des tombes y stationnent toute l'année pour enregistrer ceux qui pénètrent dans les épaves et protéger les reliques importantes.
Masses of scrapped ships are piled atop a sea of fiery red flowers, like a funeral held for them. A small number of people from different races live here, leading a life far from civilization.

Un grand nombre de navires au rebut s'entassent sur une mer de fleurs rouge feu, comme s'il s'agissait de funérailles organisées pour eux. Quelques personnes issues de différentes ethnies vivent ici, menant une vie loin de toute civilisation.

After being cut off from Kepler's supplies, the exiled refugees could only survive by scavenging the wreckage of civilization and dismantling old facilities. Amidst pollution, medicine shortages, and the struggle for resources, they gradually became the Scavengers. The Scavenger King holds a monopoly on medicine supplies and uses this to maintain control over the camp.

Après avoir perdu les approvisionnements de Kepler, les réfugiés exilés ne peuvent compter que sur la collecte de Ruines décomposées de la civilisation et le démantèlement d'anciennes installations pour leur Survie. Ils sont progressivement devenus des Charognards au milieu de la contamination, de la pénurie de médicaments et de la lutte pour les ressources. Le Roi des Charognards détient les médicaments rares, maintenant ainsi son Contrôle sur le camp.
Poste de garde du chemin secondaire
The waterfall in the mountains is both a haven for cultivating one’s temperament and an excellent place for meditation. It is just unclear whether the Orcs have the sensibility to appreciate it.
Les cascades de la montagne sont à la fois un lieu idéal pour cultiver l'esprit et un endroit parfait pour la méditation. Reste à savoir si les Orcs ont la sensibilité nécessaire pour les apprécier.
In a remote corner of the island, the Chelae are always holding lively celebrations here. As for what exactly they are celebrating, that question remains unanswered to this day.
Dans un coin reculé de l'île, les parias se réunissent souvent pour célébrer joyeusement. Quant à savoir ce qu'ils fêtent exactement, cette question reste à ce jour sans réponse.
On the factory's outer perimeter, Orcs' buildings are scattered everywhere, hidden among the mountains and forests and almost impossible to make out.
Sur les positions périphériques de l'usine, des structures orques sont dispersées çà et là, presque indiscernables au milieu des montagnes et des forêts.
A settlement where the Chelae live, home to a variety of facilities and venues for their daily life and entertainment.
Lieu de rassemblement où vivent les parias, abritant diverses installations et espaces dédiés à leur vie quotidienne ET à leurs divertissements.

The island occupied by the Chelae is lined with dense defensive installations along its shores. Ideologically extreme and in possession of advanced technology, the Chelae keep a tight watch over the nearby sea lanes, regarding this place as territory that outsiders are not permitted to trespass upon.

Les îles occupées par les Chelae sont parsemées de denses installations de Défense le long de leurs côtes. Ces Chelae, aux idées extrêmes et dotés de technologies avancées, surveillent étroitement les voies navigables environnantes, considérant cet endroit comme un territoire sacré interdit aux étrangers.

The Black Beach controlled by the Mad Dragon Gang is naturally fortified by stone pillars, canyons, and rugged terrain. Gang members hold positions along the roads, relying on looting and collecting tolls from passersby to survive.

La plage noire sous le Contrôle du gang du Dragon Furieux, avec ses colonnes de pierre, ses canyons et son terrain accidenté, leur offre une couverture naturelle. Les membres du gang sont retranchés le long des routes, comptant sur le pillage et la perception de péages pour leur survie.
A lone isle suspended above the vast ocean, where the Chelae have built a forward camp, like the devil's eye fixed on the Mariana's every move.
Une île isolée suspendue au-dessus de l'océan, où les Chelaes ont établi un campement d'avant-garde, tel l'œil du diable surveillant chaque mouvement des habitants de Mariana.
Scavengers set up outposts on the outskirts of the camp, responsible for guarding the side routes, transporting supplies, and providing early warnings for the main camp.

L'avant-poste des Charognards, situé à la périphérie du camp, est chargé de surveiller les chemins latéraux, de transférer l'Encensoir porte-bonheur et de fournir une alerte de mort au camp principal.
Islands scattered across the vast ocean are carpeted with dense indigo-purple sea anemones, and among them a gigantic, bewitching anemone rises from the ground, silently waving in the wind.

Des îles éparpillées sur l'océan infini sont recouvertes d'anémones de mer d'un violet indigo dense, parmi lesquelles une anémone géante et envoûtante s'élève du sol, agitant ses tentacules silencieusement dans le vent.
Chelae outposts scattered along the coastline, where the Chelae keep watch for any threats coming from sea level.
Des avant-postes de Chelae sont dispersés le long du littoral, d'où ils surveillent toute menace venant de l'horizon.
A massive pit formed by countless mushroom caverns, as intricate and labyrinthine as a maze, where even the slightest carelessness can lead to getting lost.
Un gouffre immense formé par l'alignement d'innombrables grottes de champignons, dont l'intérieur est aussi complexe qu'un labyrinthe, présentant un risque de s'égarer à la moindre inattention.

The old factory zone was once the lifeline of Harmony Town's residents, but only abandoned equipment and construction machinery remain now. The Scavengers have converted the construction machinery into weapons of violence, while Kepler retains control over a handful of key facilities.

La Vieille zone industrielle était autrefois le centre vital des habitants de Ville fantôme, mais il n'en reste aujourd'hui que des équipements abandonnés et des machines de construction. Les Charognards ont transformé ces machines en armes de violence, tandis que Kepler conserve le Contrôle ! sur quelques installations clés.
The loading yard of the old factory district once handled supply transfers. Usable equipment and material nodes are still preserved here.
La Zone de chargement de la Vieille zone industrielle servait autrefois au transit des fournitures. On y trouve encore des équipements utilisables et des points de matériaux.
The communications facilities in the old factory area are still under Kepler's control, used to monitor the area and maintain connections between the few data points.
Les installations de communication de la Vieille zone industrielle sont toujours sous le Contrôle de Kepler, servant à surveiller la zone et à maintenir la liaison entre quelques points de contrôle.
Once a diner where townsfolk and refugees gathered. Now occupied by the Scavengers, it has become their base for resting, distributing supplies, and trading information.

C'était autrefois un bar-restaurant où se rassemblaient citadins et réfugiés. Il est aujourd'hui occupé par les Charognards, leur servant de base pour se reposer, répartir les fournitures et échanger des informations.
A fruit and vegetable shop that once served townsfolk and refugees. After supplies were cut off, it was picked clean, and is now used by the Scavengers as a temporary storage point.

Un Primeur qui servait autrefois les citadins et les réfugiés. Après l'interruption des approvisionnements, la boutique a été pillée et sert désormais de point de stockage temporaire pour les Charognards.
The Iron ruins stretching across the island, where rusted Iron and jagged crags intertwine, are almost inseparable.
Les Ruines d'acier s'étendent sur l'île, où le fer rouillé et les rochers menaçants s'entrelacent jusqu'à devenir presque indissociables.

The lookout post adjacent to Devil Island is an outpost established by the Mariana, and the painful lessons of the past remind them that they must remain vigilant at all times against threats from elsewhere.

La Plateforme adjacente à l'Île du diable est un Avant-poste établi par les habitants de Mariana ; les leçons douloureuses du passé leur rappellent qu'ils doivent rester constamment sur leurs gardes face aux menaces venues d'ailleurs.

At the highest point on the White Coast, one can take in the surrounding waters and passing ships at a glance. Mariana have been stationed here year-round, keeping watch over the coast and the homeward route of their far-traveling kin.

Le point culminant de la Côte blanche offre une vue imprenable sur les eaux environnantes et les navires qui passent. Le peuple de Mariana y stationne toute l'année, veillant sur le rivage et le retour des membres de leur clan partis au loin.
The seaside cemetery where the Mariana bury their kin is also an important place of remembrance for them. The gravekeeper Silver Scale stands watch here, soothing the departed heroic spirits.

Le cimetière côtier où le peuple de Mariana enterre les siens est également un lieu de commémoration important. L'Argentécaille, le gardien des tombes, est stationné dans ce mode, apaisant les âmes héroïques disparues.

Along the coast under Mariana control lie cemeteries, settlements, and sites that carry the traditions of their people. This is both their homeland and a vital region for honoring their ancestors and sustaining their cultural heritage.

Sur la côte sous le Contrôle des Mariana, on trouve des cimetières, des colonies et des sites porteurs des traditions du groupe. C'est à la fois leur foyer et une zone importante pour commémorer les ancêtres et maintenir la culture de leur peuple.

A settlement of the Mariana people. After the second Smash-Up, the surviving Mariana came here and made it their home. That was, until their mortal enemies, the Chelae, also set foot on this land. Peace seems forever out of reach.

Le lieu de rassemblement des Mariana. Après le second Grand Effondrement, les survivants Mariana sont venus ici et en ont fait leur foyer. Jusqu'à ce que leurs ennemis jurés, les Chelae, ne foulent également cette terre. La paix semble Yong hors de portée.
A ruin assembled from all kinds of discarded metal, filled everywhere with things people no longer want. But if you search carefully, you can still find quite a few useful items.
Des ruines constituées de divers métaux abandonnés, remplies d'objets dont personne ne veut plus. Mais si vous effectuez une recherche minutieuse, vous pourrez y trouver bien des choses utiles.
A stone forest built up from stacked stone pillars, with thick, heavy pillars towering here, cannot help but make one wonder what kind of power forged such a great feat.

Une forêt de pierres formée par l'accumulation de colonnes de pierre, où se dressent des colonnes de pierre massives. On ne peut s'empêcher de ressentir de la curiosité : quel genre de puissance a pu accomplir une telle prouesse ?
The tidal flats made up of green grass and coconut trees look like a vacation resort from afar, and are also a place where Mariana people relax in their spare time.
Cette vasière composée d'herbe verte et de cocotiers ressemble de loin à une station balnéaire, et c'est aussi un lieu de détente pour les habitants de Mariana pendant leur temps libre.
The lookout point on the high ground near the camp offers a clear view of the roads leading to Harmony Town and the factory district. Scavengers keep watch here for Kepler and other outside forces.

Ce point d'observation en hauteur près du camp permet de surveiller les routes menant à Ville fantôme et à la zone industrielle. Les Charognards y sont en état d'alerte contre Kepler et les autres forces extérieures.
A secluded mountain valley far from strife, where the Chelae hide a secret outpost deep within; here, they live a peaceful, idyllic life untouched by the outside world.
Une vallée isolée loin des conflits, un bastion secret où se cachent les Parias ; ici, ils mènent une vie paisible et coupée du monde, tel un véritable jardin secret.

An old tunnel connecting Harmony Town to other regions that became impassable following a collapse. Its entrances at both ends are still valuable for hiding personnel and supplies, and it serves as a makeshift border between the Kepler and Scavenger territories.

L'ancien tunnel reliant Ville-Harmonie aux zones extérieures a perdu sa fonction de passage après un éboulement. Les entrées des deux côtés conservent une valeur stratégique pour dissimuler du personnel et des ressources, constituant une zone frontalière entre les sphères d'influence de Kepler et des Charognards.

A commercial street connecting Harmony Town's main buildings. After Kepler's influence declined, the shops gradually fell into disrepair, and it has now become an area where Scavengers gather supplies and pass through.

Rue commerçante reliant les principaux bâtiments de Ville fantôme. Après le déclin de la faction Kepler, les boutiques sont tombées en ruine, et la zone est désormais devenue un lieu de passage et de collecte de ressources pour les Charognards.

A concealed passage connecting the inside and outside of Harmony Town, allowing you to bypass the main road. Kepler controls the entrance, enabling a small number of personnel to move quickly and conduct patrols.

Un passage caché reliant l'intérieur et l'extérieur de la Ville de l'Harmonie, permettant de contourner les routes principales. Kepler en contrôle l'entrée, l'utilisant pour le passage rapide d'un petit nombre de membres du personnel et pour les missions du Superviseur.
A sentry post on the side path connecting the Chelae settlement to the outside world, where the Chelae's eyes watch over this sole route, staying alert for uninvited intruders.
Un avant-poste sur le chemin secondaire reliant le Campement des Chelae au monde extérieur ; les yeux des Chelae surveillent cet unique passage, aux aguets face aux intrus non invités.
The tunnel entrance leading to the outer area is blocked by a cave-in and cannot be used normally. Scavengers have taken over the nearby area, using it as a concealed fringe outpost.
L'entrée du tunnel menant à la zone extérieure est impraticable en raison d'un éboulement. Les Charognards occupent la zone voisine, l'utilisant comme un bastion périphérique caché.
A towering peak that disappears into the clouds, its summit nowhere in sight. But legend says that if you can reach the top, you will reap treasures beyond ordinary imagination.

Des sommets s'élevant dans les nuages, dont on ne peut apercevoir la cime d'un seul regard. Mais la LÉGENDAIRE raconte que si l'on parvient à atteindre l'Acmé, on peut récolter des trésors dépassant l'imagination du commun des mortels.
The Aesir live in Shards of extreme cold. They possess powerful energy and thermal technologies, and have made significant strides in the field of artificial prosthetics.

Les Ases vivent sur la Montagne glacée. Ils possèdent des technologies énergétiques et de chauffage avancées, et ont également réalisé des prouesses remarquables dans le domaine des prothèses artificielles.

A crustacean-like species operating under a simple hierarchy, yet in possession of highly advanced technology. Ideologically extreme and volatile in temperament, the Chelae follow a single supreme leader, under which they are obedient war machines built for conquest.

Une faction composée principalement de Carapace. Leur structure organisationnelle est assez simple, mais ils maîtrisent une technologie de pointe. Ils ont des idées extrêmes, un tempérament colérique et n'obéissent presque qu'à leur chef unique, constituant de pures armes de guerre.

The historically nomadic orcs transformed ruins into their homes, establishing settlements akin to tribal strongholds. While they're very welcoming to outsiders, they're fiercely protective of their own and more than willing to fight for what they have.

Les Orques ont transformé les ruines en foyers, formant des bastions semblables à des tribus. Ils souhaitent la bienvenue à quiconque veut les rejoindre, mais ils sont pointilleux et ne permettent jamais aux autres de leur dérober la moindre chose ; c'est un groupe ouvert mais violent.

The Shards and people of Kemet once boasted a magnificent civilization and history. Its survivors still see themselves as heirs to an ancient culture, believing that "Kemet" remains synonymous with wealth and prosperity. Having lost their queen, however, they've been forced to endure a period of decline where even survival is a desperate struggle. Someday, their queen will return; until that day, they wait.

Une race qui possédait autrefois une civilisation et une histoire des plus glorieuses. Aujourd'hui, les survivants se considèrent toujours comme les Héritier du vent de cette culture antique, estimant que Kemet reste synonyme de richesse et de prospérité. Cependant, ayant perdu leur reine, ils doivent faire face au déclin de leur influence et lutter pour leur survie, dans l'attente du retour de leur souveraine.

Originally a maritime species, the Mariani now live aboard wrecked ships in the harbor. They value kinship, revere combat and music, and celebrate diverse forms of entertainment. A lack of advanced technology means they depend on expedition teams to gather enough supplies to scrape by.

Ce peuple vivait autrefois au fond de la mer, mais il réside désormais dans des épaves de navires au port. Ils accordent une grande importance à la famille et prônent le combat ainsi que la musique. Leurs divertissements sont variés, mais ils manquent de moyens technologiques. Ils dépendent des expéditions constantes de leurs équipes d'exploration pour collecter des fournitures, afin de maintenir tant bien que mal la stabilité de leur structure sociale.

Kepler spurred on this young gang to steal the Aesir's thermal technology for themselves. Its members include both outsiders and young Aesir. Short-sighted and hotheaded, the Boiler Gang is driven by a thirst for thrills and violence, racing through blizzards on modified snowmobiles, completely oblivious to the consequences of their reckless behavior.

Sous l'impulsion de Kepler, ce jeune gang s'est emparé de la technologie de chauffage des Ases. Ses membres comptent aussi bien des étrangers que de jeunes Ases. En quête de sensations fortes et de violence, ils sont imprévisibles et impétueux. Ils parcourent le blizzard sur leurs motoneiges modifiées, totalement inconscients de la portée de leurs méfaits.

Unruly refugees who've settled on barren Shards in the wake of the second Smash-Up. They scavenge the remnants of dead civilizations to create weapons, and rely on scarce medicines to fend off glunite poisoning. The "Scavenger King" leads them, for better or worse.

Des voyous réfugiés installés sur de petits éclats désolés. Après l'effondrement de la civilisation, ils se sont armés en récupérant des débris et comptent sur des médicaments sporadiques pour résister à la pollution par la Glunite ; c'est pourquoi ils obéissent aux ordres du « Roi des récupérateurs ».

Kepler is an oligarchic tech corporation dedicated to developing cutting-edge science and technology that will further the expansion of human civilization. The company is responsible for two Shardverse-spanning Smash-Ups. In the aftermath, it maintains a facade of justice while plundering resources from vulnerable Shards.

Kepler est une entreprise technologique oligarchique dont l'objectif est d'explorer les sciences et technologies de pointe et d'étendre la civilisation humaine. Elle a provoqué par deux fois l’Effondrement de l'univers. Après la catastrophe, tout en maintenant une apparence de JUSTICE, Kepler pille frénétiquement les ressources de chaque jour.

The company is responsible for two Shardverse-spanning Smash-Ups. In the aftermath, it maintains a facade of justice while plundering resources from vulnerable Shards.

Kepler est une entreprise technologique oligarchique dont l'objectif est d'explorer les sciences et technologies de pointe et d'étendre la civilisation humaine. Elle a provoqué par deux fois l’Effondrement de l'univers. Après la catastrophe, tout en maintenant une apparence de JUSTICE, Kepler pille frénétiquement les ressources de chaque fragment.

A human gang entrenched in the Old City district. They control most of the city's resources and run several illicit operations, using violence and money to lord over the populace. While the Mad Dragons live in the neon lights of the city's luxurious central tower, citizens on the outskirts are forced to live in chaos and oppression.

Le gang humain qui occupe la vieille ville s'est emparé de la majeure partie des ressources urbaines, utilisant la violence et les PIÈCES pour exercer un Contrôle sur les masses. Ils gèrent également divers trafics illégaux, menant une vie de débauche dans les gratte-ciel du centre-ville, tandis que la population des périphéries est contrainte de vivre dans le chaos et l'oppression.
The second Smash-Up drastically altered the ecosystems of nearby Shards via glunite contamination. Mutated animals have been roaming the wilderness ever since.
Après le second Smash Up, les écosystèmes d'éclats ont été affectés par la pollution au Glunite, entraînant l'apparition de nombreux animaux en mutation errant dans la nature.
A neutral region inhabited by various races.
Une zone neutre où cohabitent diverses races.
Roi des récupérateurs · Brutus au visage rouillé

The Scavenger King, leader of the Scavengers and the unquestioned ruler of The Fringe Sector, is cruel and violent, showing no mercy even to his own men. Yet despite that, he is still surrounded by hordes of lackeys. As for the reason, ultimately it may be because he pays full social security for every Scavenger.

Le Roi des charognards, chef des Charognards et dirigeant incontesté du Secteur périphérique, possède un caractère cruel et violent, ne montrant aucune pitié même envers ses propres subordonnés. Pourtant, il est toujours entouré d'une foule de sbires ; la raison en est simple : il paie scrupuleusement la sécurité sociale de chaque Charognard.

Do you want to know about the hatred between us and the Outcasts? That chapter of the past is too painful to look back on.

Sneak into the village and bring back some supplies!

Angry at them, angry at Kepler, and angry at myself.
En colère contre eux, en colère contre Kepler, et en colère contre moi.
Becoming a warrior is an inevitable path, and everyone must go through it.
C'est un passage obligé pour devenir un guerrier, tout le monde doit passer par là.

#A clip from an online science explainer video.

You know, everyone’s heard of famous Lancers like Corona, Ixchel, and Serket. We all know they come from parallel-universe Shards that Acme identified long ago: Aesir, Balamtok, and Kemet. But those are hardly the only ones that exist! An unimaginably vast number of Shards drift through the Shardverse—and a huge portion of them are completely unknown and unexplored! Acme’s expedition teams—or rather, the expedition teams of its major corporations—are still searching for those unknown Shards. And their investigation reports contain plenty of interesting findings:

More Gektarans! We not only found “The Deeps”—an underground Gektaran city—but also a multitude of Shards inhabited by unique Gektaran subspecies! Unfortunately, these subspecies tend to not be very smart, and they have none of Dex’s intelligence and refinement. It’s said there's even a fire salamander subspecies living deep underground, like some evil, primitive civilization straight out of an old-school sci-fi novel!

Windwalker’s kin? Although Windwalker says he left his homeland long ago, many “elf”-like species have been discovered—clearly his own kind, or at least related! Unfortunately, these mysterious elves don’t recognize Windwalker (perhaps they'd know him by a different name?), and they seem to be trying to find a new home.

Orcs! Yes, really! Dex, Hurricane, and Sonar's races were thus far the only friendly non-humans we knew of, but no longer! I don’t yet know the official scientific name for these guys, but they look exactly like the orcs in all your favorite fantasy games and movies. This nomadic race is scattered all over the Shardverse with no fixed home, drifting between Shards.

And now, here's the latest news on the Chelae—also known as the Fallen—and the Parasites…

#Investigation Report Bulletin

Mr. Cly Bradley:

We have identified three suspected targets. Upon cross-referencing their physical profiles against the visual materials you provided, we found, in each instance, a match probability exceeding 90%. We're afraid your suspicions may be correct: Kepler has dispatched at least one assassin robot, apparently to carry out covert ops missions originally intended for the Lancer Zephyr. However, although you claim this assassin robot existed before the Smash-Up, we cannot confirm whether the email records you supplied regarding your mother’s work are sufficient enough to substantiate this claim. It is possible that Kepler developed a powerful assassin robot long ago—one whose capabilities, based on the targets, may even match those of a Lancer—and it has shown recent signs of activity. But we require further intelligence to support this intriguing hypothesis, especially as it pertains to the timeline you claim.

—The Investigation Team

# Eastvale Secret File 01
To All Lancers,
Following the initiation of the long-term investigation project into the Kepler Group, investigation team has faced various obstacles. Thanks to the Lancer Association for their generous support, and we will strive to gather intelligence to provide the necessary information to all Lancers in a neutral manner. Our goal is not to overthrow any particular force or company, but simply to help everyone live and fight more effectively.
Recently, the investigation team also launched an inquiry into the Eastvale Holdings, and here are already some preliminary findings:
As we all know, the Eastvale Holdings is a large conglomerate that holds a near-monopoly in industries such as manufacturing, logistics, and finance. However, within this massive entity, its management appears to be engaged in some form of power struggle behind the scenes. Various signs indicate that the current CEO, Mr. Chang, has deep conflicts with the Eastvale Board of Directors, particularly with the nine executive directors. The relevant clues we have collected include:
- The number of decisions made and implemented by the Eastvale Board has significantly increased. It seems that the board is deliberately vying for management rights
- Before the Smash-Up, CEO Chang Shijie survived an assassination attempt. - After arriving in Shardverse, the Eastvale Holdings rapidly acquired the manufacturing technology patents for shard cards and established multiple shard card factories. Comme chacun sait, la Compagnie Géante Eastvale est un conglomérat très vaste qui détient pratiquement le monopole dans les secteurs industriel, logistique et financier. Pourtant, malgré cette taille colossale, ses dirigeants semblent constamment engagés dans une sorte de lutte pour le pouvoir en coulisses. Plusieurs indices indiquent que M. Chang Shijie, actuel PDG d'Eastvale, entretient des tensions profondes avec le conseil d'administration d'Eastvale, notamment avec les neuf administrateurs permanents. Les indices que nous avons recueillis sont les suivants :
- Le nombre de décisions prises et mises en œuvre par le conseil d'administration d'Eastvale a considérablement augmenté. Il semble que ce dernier cherche délibérément à prendre le contrôle.

L'arme utilisée par l'assassin a été identifiée comme étant un nouveau fusil de sniper électromagnétique développé par le laboratoire d'armes Mountain Weasel, portant le nom de code « Hollowpoint » – oui, exactement celui que vous connaissez tous très bien. Cette tentative d'assassinat ratée reste entourée de nombreux points obscurs. Par exemple, il était pratiquement impossible pour quelqu'un qui n'appartenait pas au cercle restreint d'avoir connaissance des déplacements de Chang Shijie, et pourtant l'assassin connaissait à l'avance la position précise de sa cible et a réussi à toucher directement la voiture blindée dans laquelle se trouvait Chang Shijie avec un seul tir. La seule chose que nous sachions, c’est que des membres internes d’Eastvale ont ordonné à Hollowpoint, qui n’en savait rien, de mener cette audacieuse opération d’assassinat. Hollowpoint, quant à elle, ignorait seulement qu’on lui demandait d’éliminer « la plus grande menace pour l’entreprise ». 
- Après être arrivée dans l’éclatsverse, Eastvale Holdings a acquis en un temps record le brevet de fabrication des Cartes d'Éclat et a créé plusieurs usines spécialisées dans leur production. Cependant, selon l'enquête, une usine de Carte d'Éclat était située à côté du célèbre Marché noir d'Acme, où elle tolérait discrètement les activités sombres telles que la contrebande de Cartes d'Éclat. De plus, le responsable de cette usine semblait avoir des liens étroits avec le conseil d'administration d'Eastvale. Récemment, suite à une fuite de Glunite causée par une mauvaise gestion des Cartes d'Éclat, ce responsable faisait l'objet d'une enquête menée par l'équipe du cabinet du PDG d'Eastvale. C'est pourquoi les Lancer se rendent sur le Marché noir et dans l'Usine centrale pour accomplir des Mission(s). 
Néanmoins, nous ne pouvons toujours pas confirmer s'il existe réellement des conflits internes au sein de la direction d'Eastvale, ni si ces conflits influenceront les futures actions d'Eastvale. Toutefois, selon une suggestion faite par un membre de l'équipe d'enquête et fournisseur d'indices, toute personne participant aux Mission(s) publiées par Eastvale devrait faire attention à tout élément suspect (comme des objectifs vagues, des détails manquants ou des conditions irréalistes), afin d'éviter involontairement d'être entraînée dans la lutte de pouvoir du groupe.

# A Letter to Newcomers
Hello, rookie:
Acme is now your home in the Shardverse. You can feel sadness, confusion, or even anger. Cheer up! Whether you came here voluntarily or were unceremoniously flung through a portal on the corner, you need to understand this lonely city, the small Shard we live in.
Acme used to be a great city, a place of crazy wealth! It was originally a massive artificial city located on the equator of Earth, established through a temporary cooperation by giant companies Kepler and Eastvale. (In case you don’t know what "Earth" is, it's the planet where Acme was located before the Smash-Up). You saw the Spire, the tall building in the middle of town? Used to be there was a skyhook that went up to an orbital satellite, so you could take an elevator up to orbit. Now it's just condos, offices and a big mall.
These companies intended to create a free city unregulated by the government, but they went too far. Who could have guessed, right? Some Kepler scientists played with catastrophe physics a little too hard, and the entire city was ripped off the planet and appeared here, in this lovely little void in the Shardverse. 
Since the whole point of Acme was there was no real government, after the disaster, the companies came together to form an organization called the "Acme Committee," acting as the leader of the city. The Committee organized post-disaster reconstruction, ensured food and energy supplies for the entire city,  and set up a series of special agencies to handle emergency affairs. Oh, the Lancer Association is not included in that; we are merely nominally under the Committee’s jurisdiction. You surely don’t know how many times we clashed with Kepler and Eastvale right after the Smash-Up. During those disputes, the Committee eventually compromised: they sent people to sign a pact with us to establish the Lancer Association. The Association will not restrict you from doing anything, nor will they make you wear any explosive neck collars; they will only ask you to register your information and then harmlessly track your movements. I know that doesn’t sound quite right, but hold on! Their aim is merely to ensure that Lancers don’t do anything too outrageous, like drill a hole in the city or something. They wanna make sure that if someone does something stupid, it's them. 
Key point:  Acme needs a continuous supply of glunite so our tiny Shard doesn't disintegrate. So they need a platform to contact the Lancers and dispatch those glunite collection missions.
All right, you now have a general idea of the city, so get ready for some missions! New portals are continually appearing across Acme, and the Lancers are the only ones who can safely explore them. Accept missions, join a squad, meet new faces from various Shards, and go collect glunite! There are many weird but fundamentally righteous Lancers in the Association, and I hope you all become good friends.
 Cly Bradley ("Broker" to my friends, "Uh oh" to my enemies)

#A Helpful Guide from Nitro
Hello, howdy, and hi, all you starter cars! Er. Newcomers. New Lancers.
Welcome to the Lancer Association! Maybe you just became a Lancer, or maybe you're experienced already; whatever your case, living as a Lancer in Acme means you gotta follow the rules of the road. And if you're thinking, oh no, I don't have my license, I don't know how to drive, I'll just run everyone over—don’t worry, this guide is here to help you!
First off, congrats! Becoming a Lancer means you've survived high-risk exposure to glunite and successfully gained the ability to control it. You'll still get hurt, feel pain, break bones, and all that, but you don’t have to fear death anymore: as long as your self-awareness remains clear, glunite will rebuild your body. You're basically immortal! Although scientists have yet to fully understand the underlying principles of reconstitution, for Lancers, this ability is almost instinctual. And while some of you may feel the same as before, many more may now be discovering all sorts of abilities—like creating fire and electricity from glunite, entering mysterious subspaces, or even making decoys that look like themselves! Give it a try: you might have a unique superpower too!
Even though you're no longer an ordinary person, life as a Lancer is still subject to certain constraints. For example! If you don't regularly replenish your glunite energy stores, your body will gradually destabilize—and that's not fun! It's kinda like a new food source for you that takes precedence over everything else. You don't wanna starve yourself, do you? Of course not! Some even say that if a Lancer fails to absorb glunite for an extended period, they might go insane or even dissipate altogether… Ugh, so scary! I hope those are just rumors. But hey, don’t worry! Joining the Lancer Association gives you automatic access to basic living support so none of that ever happens!
But Nitro, you might say, I still don't even know what your association is! I've got your answer right here.The Lancer Association is the organization managing all Lancers in Acme. They record your information, provide you with a place to stay, and regularly supply glunite for your sustenance. Once you're in, you can stay with the Association as long as you want—they only require you not to use your abilities for destruction. So no road rage allowed! In fact, you can even find administrative work in the Association to keep boredom at bay. If that's your thing. There's, uh, other things you can do too.
For instance! If you believe you've got the chops for combat, you’re welcome to join the Lancer Corps, a sub-organization that accepts missions around Acme and operates in small squads. Sometimes these missions have opposing goals or employers, which means that conflict between squads happens a lot. My advice is: just fight! Have fun with it! Word to the wise, though: if something dangerous happens in Acme, members of the Lancer Corps are expected to be at the forefront to deal with it. This is normal. Lancer Corps members receive more sustenance glunite resources and thus bear responsibilities more akin to a “special forces” unit. It's worth the risks though! You get to travel to all sorts of Shards and meet all sorts of friends.
Anyway, that's a lot of talking from me and I think I got everything. I probably did. Maybe. I look forward to your joining the Lancer Association and/or Corps, new friends! If you have any questions or want me to craft some personalized gear for you, just come on by! Chug-Chug doesn't bite, promise.
—From Nanae Lopez, the super engineer currently building a drone empire!

# Dossier d'enquête secrète de Kepler 02
Chers collègues Lanciers :
Nous devons réitérer à tous, dès le début de ce Dossier : le Groupe Kepler est devenu extrêmement dangereux, et toute Mission liée à lui doit être menée avec une prudence extrême. Nous avons des raisons de croire que Kepler a acquis, par certains canaux, des technologies dépassant de loin le niveau technologique humain.
Environ au moment de l'incident de la Ligne de Front des Jouets, le mode d'Événement de Kepler a subi un changement notable. Avant cela, Kepler était comme un nouveau-né arrivant dans un nouveau monde, faisant preuve de Curiosité envers chaque direction et investissant une énergie considérable dans chaque projet. Mais maintenant, Kepler a supprimé un grand nombre de projets périphériques pour concentrer toutes ses ressources sur plusieurs recherches secrètes liées au développement de fragments et à la technologie Glunite. Kepler n'est plus l'entreprise qui, juste après l'« Effondrement unique », semblait se soucier de la population, formait le Comité Acmé et s'investissait pleinement dans la reconstruction après la catastrophe. Ils ignorent désormais les appels du public et se montrent hostiles envers les Lanciers, comme s'ils étaient les véritables maîtres de l'éclatsverse — et Kepler semble vraiment s'efforcer d'aller dans cette direction.
De manière très inattendue, nous avons reçu l'aide d'une personne interne — le Dr Jeanine Voclain. Elle nous a fourni des informations cruciales : Kepler tente de créer une légion artificielle totalement obéissante, dont les Lanciers actuels sont les ennemis imaginaires. Parallèlement, une série de plans ciblant les Lanciers et leurs super-pouvoirs Glunite connaît une Diminution de la vitesse, incluant l'incident précédent de la Ligne de Front des Jouets ainsi que le projet Bastion mortel ; par essence, tous étudient la source du pouvoir des Lanciers. Malheureusement, même avec les tentatives d'obstruction du Dr Voclain, les recherches concernées continuent de produire des résultats. Une ère pleine de malveillance envers les Lanciers approche.
Plus terrifiant encore, le niveau de développement technologique de Kepler dépasse de loin celui de toute autre organisation. Leur déploiement au cours des dernières années a enfin révélé son tranchant : grâce à de nombreux contacts avec d'autres fragments de l'éclatsverse, ils ont acquis une quantité massive de connaissances technologiques de civilisations extérieures et ont réalisé de nombreuses percées techniques grâce à elles. Des rumeurs prétendent même que Kepler aurait des liens avec les « Chelaes » — l'envahisseur qui a envahi Mariana et créé les Parasites pourrait avoir eu des contacts secrets avec Kepler et conclu une sorte de coopération, ce qui expliquerait peut-être pourquoi les Chelaes n'ont pas encore lancé d'Attaquer formelle après les Parasites. Ou alors, Kepler a simplement obtenu secrètement des soldats ou des Jouets OVNI des Chelaes par un moyen quelconque et a commencé à les étudier...
Mais à ce jour, l'équipe d'Enquête n'a toujours pas trouvé de preuves définitives pour prouver totalement la véracité de ce qui précède. L'équipe d'Enquête continuera son Enquête jusqu'à ce que toute la lumière soit faite.

#Jocasta News

Hey, Lancers! So I have good news and bad news. Good news first: recent months have seen fewer and fewer violent conflicts across the Shardverse! Yay! Bad news: as you might imagine, less violence means less work for us...even if it is better for everyone else. Aww. But I bet you can guess why. Ever since that indie reporter spread that story about the "Glunite Apocalypse," the whole Shardverse has gone quiet. Like the calm before a really big, really devastating storm. Everyone I observe looks like they're planning something, heads down, busy with personal matters... Honestly, I really miss the noise and chaos from before.

What about you? Are you busy too? Maybe this is weird to say, but lately I have this growing feeling of dread that you'll all be leaving me soon. Call it an AI's intuition. I'm not sure if you're all gonna die or all gonna leave the Association, and I dunno which would be worse for me. Before all this, no matter how hard everyone fought or how serious the drama got, it would always end with harmless razzing and laughter. Now, even that's rare...

And look, I know that most of you don't take me seriously. But I'm being super serious right now: I know how hard it's been for all of you. We're not some all-powerful organization or megacorp. Internal and external pressure has been a constant since the Association was founded. People doubt your intentions, doubt your abilities, and doubt whether you can bring true change to Acme. Well, those people aren't me! I'm sure that those of you still holding the line have as much passion for change as you started with. And I've heard the rumors: you're preparing something big, right? Some major event (or events)? Whatever it is, I believe in you, and I hope that someday soon, everyone else will believe in you too.

I can feel it in my code. Someday...maybe next year, maybe as early as next month, you're gonna fight a huge battle to save the Shardverse. Until then, please don't go! Show everyone who the Lancers really are! Show them you're heroes! I'll be with you every step of the way, no matter how long it takes. Just don't go perma-dying before it happens, okay?

-Jocasta, your favorite, lonely AI

# Jocasta News  
Do you remember Shard 01821 that was discovered earlier this week? Our veteran Lancer squad conducted a preliminary survey and concluded that "this is a Shard from Balamtok."  To protect their reputation, I'm not naming names here. I'll just tell these three people, the one wearing the yellow cap, the one who tosses wrenches around, and the one who deals in rocket launchers: this Shard is not from Balamtok! Those people who do come from Balamtok were merely transported here by the Smash-Up, and they have no idea what this floating island is.  
The latest information we have is that there is a floating island belonging to an entirely new civilization, and we know nothing about the parallel world it belongs to. The floating island, codenamed "Itzamna" (I know, some of you gave it a Balamtok name, whatever) is a combination of an art plaza and a passenger center, featuring unique anti-gravity technology. So far, no one has found any survivors from this new civilization.  
According to the latest news,  anti-gravity technology is being researched by the megacorps—Kepler and Eastvale, duh. Guess where they stole the tech from? As before, we have received numerous conflict reports regarding Itzamna. The Lancer Association is just a loose platform; we are not obligated to monitor what missions you take on, for whom you work, or whom you fight with. However, we are very concerned about the potential risks that Lancer battles may pose! Shard 01821 is a brand new and possibly unstable Shard, and follow-up exploration plans are already in the works. There are certainly many people who do not want Itzamna to fall out of the sky… I may be an AI, but I don't enjoy writing hundreds of reports about the shenanigans you guys do every day!  
Back to the point. I heard that the new training base will utilize anti-gravity technology, allowing you to conduct shooting training on a safer floating island! Oh, of course, you may have already arrived at the new base, since this message will remain in the database. I receive daily complaints from residents about noises from the old base, so do me a favor and move over to the new base quickly, okay?  
From Jocasta—the AI who cares most about you

#An email from Dr. Jeanine Voclain.

To all my naive, silly little morels:

Don’t get the wrong idea—this isn’t a job application. Your invitations are useless to me until you have enough funding to build a proper bio-lab. Once that's taken care of, I might consider.

But since Mr. Bradley was so very sincere the last time we spoke, I suppose a little private collaboration isn't entirely out of the question.

Kepler has already collected most of the Catastrophe Physics Devices (they call them Ascension Devices too, did you know that?) linked to the Smash-Up, and a little bird has told me they’re also researching tech connected to the Chelae. Even I’m not quite sure what their next move is going to be. "But Dr. Voclain," you might be crying, "remaining with Kepler is dangerous! You should get out of there!" # Thrymmology Course 01
Hello, sweethearts. The Lancer Association has informed me that they need a scientist to popularize knowledge related to thrymmology. As an excellent and reliable scientist of the Lancers, it seems that I am the only one capable of taking on this task. I don't expect you to understand much, but it is somewhat sad to have a bunch of Lancers with mushy brains as my teammates—so for the sake of our future cooperation, I hope we can all take this seriously.
"Thrymmology" is an emerging natural science that studies the essence and properties of the entire Shardverse and related materials. Or this term you might be more familiar with: "Shard-ology." Its purpose is to scientifically examine the world we inhabit after the Smash-Up and to provide targeted assistance for us to survive and live in this new world. Mediocre scholars of Acme have collaborated to establish the framework of this discipline and supplemented it with some foundational theories. These theories include preliminary explanations and conjectures regarding glunite, shards, Lancers, and the special phenomena of various shards. They respectively... Oh, sorry, your brains might not be able to handle so much information. Let's talk about glunite today.
Glunite is a special type of matter that exists in this world. It does not exist on Earth; it was only after the Smash-Up that Acme began to collect and study this miraculous substance. However, in many other shards, glunite should have already existed and been studied for quite some time. Currently, glunite has been found to have the following features:
- Glunite can serve as a source of rather excellent and clean new type of energy. All of Acme currently relies on glunite to maintain normal operations. Or any operations at all!
- The unique spatial properties of glunite can be used to maintain portals. Those affected by glunite—such as us Lancers—can use these portals without being harmed.
- Uncontrolled glunite is quite unstable and dangerous, but with sufficiently advanced technology, one can study how glunite affects different fungi joyfully every day like me. In an active state, glunite can also turn into the glowing substances you see at the target sites.
- Glunite can alter the properties and appearance of matter, though the principles behind this remain unknown. Lancers are a perfect embodiment of this property: We possess various miraculous abilities and have almost no concept of "death." We can only be shattered into a puddle of glunite, after which the glunite can reassemble our bodies. In other words, the physical form of Lancers has been completely changed by glunite.
Glunite has harmed many civilians, but they have also saved many—just like me. If you still don't understand why we must carry out glunite collection missions every day, just remember two points: Acme would collapse without glunite, and Lancers would disappear without glunite. Keep these two points in mind, and my efforts will not have been in vain.
—From Jeanine Voclain, Best Biologist, Diligent Doctor, Genius, Visionary, Connoisseur of Fungi, "Pathojen"

#Thrymmology 102
We meet again, my little morels! It's time to continue our discussion on the basics of thrymmology. I don’t know how much you remember from our last course, but frankly, I don't care! My courses, much like the times, don’t wait for fools.
So! Let's check on the homework I assigned... Wait. Zero submissions? Really? None of you could figure it out? I... Hm. That's promising.
Fine. Let’s recap: “thrymmology” is an emerging natural science that studies the entire Shardverse and its related subjects, including glunite, Shards, and Lancers—but the most important aspect of thrymmology is the Smash-Up. Believe it or not, we still don’t truly know what it is, why it happened, or if it will happen again. Life is full of mysteries, non? That's what we scientists are for.
Little in the way of visual evidence of the Smash-Up exists, and many survivors remember only a sudden brightening of the sky, the world spinning out of control, then waking up here in Acme. Altogether rather useless!
Here's what we do know:
-The occurrence of the Smash-Up is almost certainly related to glunite. In the data records published by our various research institutions, the concentration of glunite in Acme increased sharply before the Smash-Up. It is believed that, at that moment, either a) a high amount of glunite surged into the area where Acme was located; or b) latent glunite already present reacted with the introduction of new glunite to transport Acme into the Shardverse.
-In parallel worlds (ex. Balamtok, Aesir, and Kemet), the Smash-Up occurred almost simultaneously alongside our own. Each instance transported land masses and planets from across these universes into our current Shardverse, and the violent spatial tearing of the event further shattered these planets into what we now know as "Shards."
-If you're still paying attention, I have a little secret for you! Kepler has labeled this information as "confidential," but I will always break the rules for science. Plus, they can't intimidate me; I'd very well like to see them try! Ahem. So! You won't read this anywhere else, but Kepler suspects that a "Catastrophe Device” is the real culprit behind the Smash-Up. Such an ominous name! And it comes with all the ominous black market competition you'd expect. My employers really want their hands on one of these things, and they're not the only ones. (Now, now, Broker, don’t get too excited! You might have more information, but that's the extent of mine.)
Perhaps, one day, we scientific pilgrims will uncover the true nature of the Smash-Up...but that day is not today. Or perhaps thrymmology itself will trigger another disaster! Wouldn't that be exciting? Ah! Here's to the future, and all the possibilities it holds~
—From Jeanine Voclain, “The Witch of Science,” “Pathojen”
